correctness.rationale: The map from binary operations to flip-equivariant maps X²→X² reverses composition but preserves idempotence/conjugacy/commutation. Idempotents are precisely equivariant retractions. Fixed and free flip orbits give profile constraints d+sum b_i=n, a+sum c_i+sum h_j=N, d>=1. Units form S_n×(C2 wr S_N), order n!2^N N!; matching rooted fibers prove orbit-transitivity and stabilizers with b_i!2^{c_i}c_i!, 2h_j! and identical-cluster permutation factors. Commutation with retraction e is exactly g(image e) subset image e plus g(y) in fiber over g(e(y)), yielding the stated block products using B=1+b,H=1+b+2c,L=1+h. Empty-product cases including n=1 are consistent. An independent literal equivariant-map enumeration for n=2 found all 16 maps, 7 idempotents, 4 unit orbits, and commutant counts [6,6,8,8,8,8,16]; n=3 global count 706 and 31 orbits are supporting independent/package tests, not all-n proofs.
residual_risks: Finite checks only corroborate the identified closed proof steps and do not constitute infinite verification.
